purpose: Consolidated theorem package for Paper 27 insertion on boundary-state residuals, scalar-bridge quotient exhaustion, banked observable classification, and P1 background/perturbation separation.

recommended_insertion.section_title: Boundary-State Residuals: Quotient Exhaustion and P1 Background Separation
recommended_insertion.insert_after: Paper 27 Spatial CCR Lift / boundary-state discussion
recommended_insertion.guardrail: Do not claim P1 selects the full h_vec state. Claim only that residual higher-shell freedom is not a hidden fit parameter for current scalar predictions.
